name: @kickside/automation-ui
title: KickSide Automations
description: Automation control page web component for kickside/automation, over the native automation install/control/uninstall API.

wippy.description: Builds two generic web components served from /kickside-automation-manager. kickside-automation-manager lists, creates, controls, and removes Automations of every registry-native type; kickside-trigger-config edits Trigger Spec v2 for any consumer. Both use host-provided authenticated APIs and standard Wippy lifecycle events.

mode.description: "create" when mounted as the workspace "+" -> Automation create view: opens straight into the install popup and emits created/close. Unset renders the full Automations page.

parent-id.description: Workspace folder to place the new automation under (create mode; empty = root).

component-id.description: Optional owning component; scopes rows and places newly created Automations under that component.

input.description: Initial declared install inputs as a JSON object, supplied by the owning component.

type-id.description: Optional registry automation type id to preselect in create or component mode. The manager treats the id opaquely and mounts that type's declared create view.
